pages.text: A small plate that gives off an adjustable redstone signal from 0 to 15. It can be placed on any side of a solid block.$(br2)$(li)Right-click: signal +1 (after 15 it wraps to 0).$(li)Shift-right-click: signal -1 (after 0 it wraps to 15).
The current value appears above the hotbar. It also powers the block it sits on.
